messages:
sarah-support: Heads up — customers reporting 504s to hosted API since ~09:12 UTC after the deploy. Lots of identical traces pointing at edge gateway timeouts.

matt-eng: Confirmed. Ran quick query on logs, spike of `upstream_response_time` and `envoy 504` from eu-west1 frontdoors starting 09:11. P95 went from 45ms to 1.2s.

dana.ops: Any recent config changes at the edge? healthcheck or probe cadence?

raj-prodops: We rolled out a healthcheck tweak in the frontdoor autoscaler: reduced probe interval from 10s -> 2s for faster failover. That went live at 09:10.

matt-eng: That aligns. Looks like overlapping probes from many nodes created short fanout to auth+billing upstreams, exhausting h2 streams and causing Envoy to return 504 on in-flight requests.

sarah-support: Customer impact — streaming requests aborted, retry loops causing additional load. Trying to explain to ops teams now.

raj-prodops: Rolling the change back to 10s now. Patching in progress: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/frontdoor-probes -n infra`. ETA ~3m.

sre-bot: deploy bot: rollback started by raj-prodops @1767654472, status: in_progress.

matt-eng: In the meantime, mitigation steps: 1) rollback probe cadence (raj doing), 2) increase envoy concurrent streams limit on frontdoor (temp), 3) enable short-circuit failure for large fanout tenants.

dana.ops: Any quick repro steps? Can we run a synthetic with heavy probe overlap to reproduce?

matt-eng: Yes — on a test stack: run 200 concurrent healthchecks hitting /health every 2s from different IPs and also start a 1s request stream to hostedapi. Example: 

```
# from load generator
seq 1 200 | xargs -P50 -I{} curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" "https://frontdoor-eu-hosted.redwood/api/v1/health"
```

That produced many 502/504s locally when envoy stream limit set low.

raj-prodops: Rollback completed at 09:14 UTC, rollout status OK. Monitoring dashboards show error rate dropping.

sarah-support: Noted — customers seeing recovery starting ~09:15. I'll update the ticket and advise on retries/backoff.

matt-eng: Follow-ups: add a safety cap so probe windows jitter instead of synchronized cadence, and add canary stage that doesn't apply extreme probe settings cluster-wide. Also add metric for "probe-fanout" to alert earlier.

dana.ops: Agree. I'll file a short runbook item for support: how to check if probe overlap caused edge 504s and steps to rollback.

raj-prodops: Also scheduling a postmortem with infra + eng-runtime tomorrow. Adding timeline and diff of probe config to the doc.

sarah-support: Thanks team. I'll close the escalation after customer confirms 24h stable. :thumbsup:
